_instructions: Optional wording for images in public/art and public/photography. Key each entry by the exact filename. Anything you leave out still appears on the page, captioned from its filename. 'alt' is what a screen reader announces, so describe what is in the image; 'caption' is the line shown underneath.

01-night-traffic-in-fog.jpg.title: Night Traffic in Fog
01-night-traffic-in-fog.jpg.alt: A city street at night swallowed by fog, traffic lights glowing green and red through the haze and their reflections smeared across the wet asphalt.
01-night-traffic-in-fog.jpg.caption: The fog eats the avenue two blocks out.

02-rain-blurred-canyon.jpg.title: Rain-Blurred Canyon
02-rain-blurred-canyon.jpg.alt: A rain-soaked street between tall buildings seen from inside a car, headlights and red tail lights streaked into long reflections on the wet road.
02-rain-blurred-canyon.jpg.caption: Nothing is in focus and that is the point.

03-pink-neon-wet-street.jpg.title: Pink Neon, Wet Street
03-pink-neon-wet-street.jpg.alt: A midtown street at night with pink and red neon glowing above the pavement, tall buildings closing in overhead and the wet road carrying the colour back.
03-pink-neon-wet-street.jpg.caption: Pink neon above a street that was already soaked.

04-castle-in-green-light.jpg.title: Castle in Green Light
04-castle-in-green-light.jpg.alt: A crenellated red brick building lit bright green along every edge at night, bare winter trees in front of it and the green glow receding down the wet street.
04-castle-in-green-light.jpg.caption: Snow on the ground, green on the walls.

05-looking-up-into-fog.jpg.title: Looking Up Into Fog
05-looking-up-into-fog.jpg.alt: A steep upward view of city towers at night, purple and magenta signs glowing on the facades while the tops of the buildings disappear into low cloud.
05-looking-up-into-fog.jpg.caption: Look up and the buildings stop before the sky does.

06-green-light-yellow-cab.jpg.title: Green Light, Yellow Cab
06-green-light-yellow-cab.jpg.alt: A narrow night street walled in by towers, tall green light panels down one side and a yellow taxi stopped ahead on the wet road.
06-green-light-yellow-cab.jpg.caption: Green the whole length of the block, and one yellow cab.

07-neon-and-rain.jpg.title: Neon and Rain
07-neon-and-rain.jpg.alt: A night street lined with green vertical neon above a yellow taxi and traffic, raindrops beaded across the lens and the wet road doubling every light.
07-neon-and-rain.jpg.caption: Rain on the lens, green down the block.

08-screening-time.jpg.title: Screening Time
08-screening-time.jpg.alt: A wet night street beneath a tall billboard reading Screening Time, a yellow taxi and dark cars stopped ahead, and a rain covered side mirror in the foreground.
08-screening-time.jpg.caption: The billboard says Screening Time. The mirror says stay where you are.

09-fire-escape-and-citi-bikes.jpg.title: Fire Escape and Citi Bikes
09-fire-escape-and-citi-bikes.jpg.alt: A brick tenement at night with black fire escapes and window air conditioners above a warmly lit restaurant awning, blue Citi Bikes docked along the wet sidewalk.
09-fire-escape-and-citi-bikes.jpg.caption: Docked bikes, a lit awning, and a fire escape nobody needed tonight.

10-red-script-neon.jpg.title: Red Script Neon
10-red-script-neon.jpg.alt: A red neon sign in flowing script reading Milk, mounted on a dark brick wall with warm pendant bulbs hanging beside it.
10-red-script-neon.jpg.caption: Milk, in the reddest handwriting in the city.

11-walls-of-photographs.jpg.title: Walls of Photographs
11-walls-of-photographs.jpg.alt: The interior of a warmly lit bar whose brick walls are papered edge to edge with old photographs, with a hand painted sign reading You Can't Beat... above them.
11-walls-of-photographs.jpg.caption: Every wall in here is somebody's good night.

12-red-carpet-entrance.jpg.title: Red Carpet Entrance
12-red-carpet-entrance.jpg.alt: A red neon Love Story sign above a doorway lined with warm marquee bulbs, reflected in the dark window beside it.
12-red-carpet-entrance.jpg.caption: Love Story, lit up, waiting for somebody to walk in.

13-golden-arches-at-night.jpg.title: Golden Arches at Night
13-golden-arches-at-night.jpg.alt: A McDonald's storefront glowing through night scaffolding, its yellow arches and red panels bright against the dark street.
13-golden-arches-at-night.jpg.caption: Golden arches under scaffolding, still the brightest thing on the block.

14-corner-store-in-snow.jpg.title: Corner Store in Snow
14-corner-store-in-snow.jpg.alt: A brick corner building at night with a bright shop window of purple and orange light, a snow covered car and a stopped white car on the street in front.
14-corner-store-in-snow.jpg.caption: The corner store is the only warm thing on the block.

15-snow-along-the-park-fence.jpg.title: Snow Along the Park Fence
15-snow-along-the-park-fence.jpg.alt: A cleared sidewalk beside a black park fence in snow, long shadows across the path, a yellow parking sign and a green trash bin ahead.
15-snow-along-the-park-fence.jpg.caption: The fence, the yellow sign, and a path somebody already walked.

16-blue-hour-in-the-snow.jpg.title: Blue Hour in the Snow
16-blue-hour-in-the-snow.jpg.alt: A city park at blue hour with snow banked along the paths, wet ground reflecting the street lamps, and dark buildings behind the trees.
16-blue-hour-in-the-snow.jpg.caption: Blue hour, and the fountain has already given up.

17-tire-tracks-at-dusk.jpg.title: Tire Tracks at Dusk
17-tire-tracks-at-dusk.jpg.alt: A snow covered street at dusk with dark tire tracks running down the middle, bare trees and a brick building along one side.
17-tire-tracks-at-dusk.jpg.caption: Somebody drove out first and left the route.

18-footprints-across-the-field.jpg.title: Footprints Across the Field
18-footprints-across-the-field.jpg.alt: A wide snow covered park field with a line of footprints crossing it toward a bare tree, and grey winter sky above.
18-footprints-across-the-field.jpg.caption: Someone walked here before us.

19-lamplight-on-wet-snow.jpg.title: Lamplight on Wet Snow
19-lamplight-on-wet-snow.jpg.alt: Street lamps and their warm reflections on wet, half melted snow along a park edge at dusk, dark green kiosks in the middle distance.
19-lamplight-on-wet-snow.jpg.caption: The lamps do all the work once the snow turns to slush.

20-benches-under-snow.jpg.title: Benches Under Snow
20-benches-under-snow.jpg.alt: A snow covered path lined with chained bicycles and empty park benches, footprints pressed into the snow beside them.
20-benches-under-snow.jpg.caption: The bikes are chained. The benches are not sitting.

21-quiet-street-in-snow.jpg.title: Quiet Street in Snow
21-quiet-street-in-snow.jpg.alt: A narrow residential street under fresh snow with parked cars, bare trees and a low stone wall, and no traffic anywhere.
21-quiet-street-in-snow.jpg.caption: No traffic, no sound, just the walk home.

22-the-long-path.jpg.title: The Long Path
22-the-long-path.jpg.alt: A snow covered park path with empty benches along it, bare trees and brick buildings under a pale winter sky.
22-the-long-path.jpg.caption: The long way round, which is the whole point of snow.

23-snowfield.jpg.title: Snowfield
23-snowfield.jpg.alt: An open snow covered field with a single set of footprints wandering across it toward bare trees, under a flat grey sky.
23-snowfield.jpg.caption: One set of prints, and no hurry in them.

24-cast-iron-corner.jpg.title: Cast Iron Corner
24-cast-iron-corner.jpg.alt: A cast iron building corner covered in graffiti and pale arches, a red street sign at the top, glowing in flat winter light.
24-cast-iron-corner.jpg.caption: Graffiti on cast iron, lit like a stage.

25-the-tall-one.jpg.title: The Tall One
25-the-tall-one.jpg.alt: A dark tower rising behind a pale stone building, seen from the street against a cloudy evening sky.
25-the-tall-one.jpg.caption: One tower pretending not to be uptown.

26-red-jacket.jpg.title: Red Jacket
26-red-jacket.jpg.alt: People crossing a sidewalk in front of a shop window marked Family, one of them in a bright red jacket, others in coats and hats.
26-red-jacket.jpg.caption: A red jacket crossing in front of a shop called Family.

27-everyone-is-going-somewhere.jpg.title: Everyone Is Going Somewhere
27-everyone-is-going-somewhere.jpg.alt: A busy midtown sidewalk with people walking in both directions past storefronts, planters and traffic on the street beside them.
27-everyone-is-going-somewhere.jpg.caption: Midtown, and everyone has a destination but me.

28-hydrant-and-blue-sky.jpg.title: Hydrant and Blue Sky
28-hydrant-and-blue-sky.jpg.alt: A black fire hydrant and a metal trash bin on a city corner with traffic passing behind, under a wide blue sky.
28-hydrant-and-blue-sky.jpg.caption: A hydrant, a bin, and the best sky of the week.

29-the-city-across-the-water.jpg.title: The City Across the Water
29-the-city-across-the-water.jpg.alt: The Manhattan skyline seen across grey water from the far shore, towers stacked densely under a pale sky.
29-the-city-across-the-water.jpg.caption: The skyline from the far side, where it finally looks quiet.

30-grey-water-grey-skyline.jpg.title: Grey Water, Grey Skyline
30-grey-water-grey-skyline.jpg.alt: A grey river and a grey skyline under low cloud, with a rocky shoreline in the foreground and a few gulls on the rocks.
30-grey-water-grey-skyline.jpg.caption: Grey on grey, and I still stood there.

31-arches-at-sunset.jpg.title: Arches at Sunset
31-arches-at-sunset.jpg.alt: A tall McDonald's sign in front of an orange and pink sunset, with a car on the road below and dark trees along the horizon.
31-arches-at-sunset.jpg.caption: The sun went down behind the sign and everyone drove past.

32-the-chair-by-the-table.jpg.title: The Chair by the Table
32-the-chair-by-the-table.jpg.alt: Kai, a beagle and spaniel mix with a black and brown head and a white speckled body, sitting upright in a chair at a table with a floral cloth.
32-the-chair-by-the-table.jpg.caption: Kai has decided this is his chair now.

33-sofa-arm-puppy.jpg.title: Sofa Arm Puppy
33-sofa-arm-puppy.jpg.alt: Close view of Kai as a puppy, head tilted over the arm of a sofa, one floppy ear forward and the room blurred behind him.
33-sofa-arm-puppy.jpg.caption: Kai at the sofa arm, deciding whether I am worth leaving.

34-puppy-and-the-green-toy.jpg.title: Puppy and the Green Toy
34-puppy-and-the-green-toy.jpg.alt: Kai asleep in a grey dog bed with his front legs wrapped around a bright green plush toy, his white body speckled with brown.
34-puppy-and-the-green-toy.jpg.caption: Kai asleep with the green toy he refuses to give up.

35-head-down.jpg.title: Head Down
35-head-down.jpg.alt: Kai's head filling the frame, nose down and eyes low, the speckled white and brown fur of his face in close detail.
35-head-down.jpg.caption: Kai, head down and nose working.

36-through-the-glass-door.jpg.title: Through the Glass Door
36-through-the-glass-door.jpg.alt: Kai standing on a wet patio outside a glass door, his white coat damp and his collar dark, waiting to be let inside.
36-through-the-glass-door.jpg.caption: Kai through the glass, wet from the garden, waiting to be let in.

37-monkey-with-a-scarf.jpg.title: Monkey with a Scarf
37-monkey-with-a-scarf.jpg.alt: A Monchhichi doll in a red bandana held up in the foreground, with Kai the beagle behind it in profile, wearing a black collar.
37-monkey-with-a-scarf.jpg.caption: The Monchhichi wears the bandana. Kai wears the expression.

38-white-room.jpg.title: White Room
38-white-room.jpg.alt: A close, slightly soft view of Kai's face, his brown patches and white muzzle filling the frame.
38-white-room.jpg.caption: Kai's face, at the distance he insists on.

39-empty-bowl.jpg.title: Empty Bowl
39-empty-bowl.jpg.alt: Kai eating dry food from a metal bowl on a giraffe print blanket, his brown and white head down over the dish.
39-empty-bowl.jpg.caption: Kai finishing dinner on the giraffe blanket.

40-lollipop-inspection.jpg.title: Lollipop Inspection
40-lollipop-inspection.jpg.alt: Kai sniffing a large rainbow spiral lollipop held out in front of his nose, his brown and white face close to the candy.
40-lollipop-inspection.jpg.caption: Kai inspects a lollipop and finds it suspicious.

41-black-cat-indoors.jpg.title: Black Cat Indoors
41-black-cat-indoors.jpg.alt: George, a black cat with yellow green eyes, sitting on a wooden floor and looking straight up at the camera.
41-black-cat-indoors.jpg.caption: George, on the wood floor, deciding whether you are allowed.

42-black-cat-on-the-floor.jpg.title: Black Cat on the Floor
42-black-cat-on-the-floor.jpg.alt: George, a black cat with bright eyes, lying on a grey bath mat beside a shower door, one paw tucked under him.
42-black-cat-on-the-floor.jpg.caption: George on the bath mat, guarding a shower he will not enter.

43-lets-take-a-break-from-watching.jpg.title: Let's Take a Break from Watching
43-lets-take-a-break-from-watching.jpg.alt: A hand drawn window decal of three cartoon snacks with faces, a speech bubble reading Let's take a break from watching, and a note reading x-tra Butter.
43-lets-take-a-break-from-watching.jpg.caption: The window says take a break from watching. The popcorn disagrees.

44-farm-fresh-ingredients.jpg.title: Farm Fresh Ingredients
44-farm-fresh-ingredients.jpg.alt: The inside of an ice cream shop with a round blue sign reading Farm Fresh around a smiling cow face, and a red paper lantern beside it.
44-farm-fresh-ingredients.jpg.caption: Farm Fresh, and a cow who has never met a farm.

45-departure-gate-panda.jpg.title: Departure Gate Panda
45-departure-gate-panda.jpg.alt: A small panda plush sitting in a black bag on an airplane seat, its tag still attached, the cabin rows behind it.
45-departure-gate-panda.jpg.caption: A panda at the departure gate, more patient than the rest of us.

46-doll-at-the-shore.jpg.title: Doll at the Shore
46-doll-at-the-shore.jpg.alt: A Monchhichi doll in a pink floral dress held up against blue water and a bright sky, wooden pilings along the shoreline behind her.
46-doll-at-the-shore.jpg.caption: A doll at the shore, dressed for a party the sea did not attend.

47-popcorn-before-the-film.jpg.title: Popcorn Before the Film
47-popcorn-before-the-film.jpg.alt: A bowl piled with popcorn and a glass of dark beer on a wooden table, a dark bottle and plates beside them, before a screening.
47-popcorn-before-the-film.jpg.caption: Popcorn before the film, which is the best part of the film.

48-hippo-and-hare.jpg.title: Hippo and Hare
48-hippo-and-hare.jpg.alt: Two bronze statues, a hippopotamus and a hare, seated across a small round table from each other playing chess.
48-hippo-and-hare.jpg.caption: A hippo and a hare, playing chess, both of them cheating.
